text: Research iteration 2 brief: both cold research reviews so far found one defect class, credit 'in his own name' for words an author only reports (Ambrose, Exp. in Luc. VII.187-189) or copies verbatim from an earlier writer (Rabanus, In Mt. IV, from Bede, In Luc. IV). The brief named that class and asked the worker to check every compiler or catena-style attribution and every 'holds' claim against its locus. No content conclusion was supplied. The brief also opened the earlier research iterations' download folders read-only, with hashes to be re-verified.
